limitations: Two actual NEW400Hz PhysX-trained actors evaluated in native CPU MuJoCo, not MJWarp and not a200Hz substitute.
Only explicit body/COM beta reward changes2->0; nonzero sideslip remains a valid motion feature. Wheel-beta reward is not introduced.
One seed/episode per condition, with training GPU4 versus GPU6; matched configuration/initialization does not establish a statistical causal effect or hardware robustness.
Core1.44–4s can hide later loss of balance. Also inspect reference-overlap0–6.96s and fullnative0–6.98s; lowerHF alone is not improvement.
Persistent tilt30/45/60deg for0.1s is a diagnostic with onset/confirmation/censoring, not a termination or absoluteheight gate.
Native counts/Fz eligibility is not a flight label. All poses, heights and the entire post-core trajectory are retained.
Reference ends6.96s; full6.98s tracking is unavailable without extrapolation. Contact/tilt/HF still use the full native horizon.
Copied completed metadata and remote strict proofs bind actor hashes; no checkpoint/actor weights are downloaded or executed locally.
Same mathematical15term stage reward and weights, not identical return optimization: CEM gamma=.99 for30steps(.6s), no terminalvalue; PPO has a learned discounted value.
PPO was trained in PhysX with DR; CEM uses full simulator state/reference preview and a native MuJoCo predictor. This is not an optimizer-only comparison.
Only CEM has full measured all-body contact history for exact episode stage-reward reconstruction. PPO total returns are unavailable, not imputed.
Native400Hz, mu=.7, original reset state and compiled plant readbacks match. MuJoCo contact/soft-limit observables need not equal PhysX training observations.
CEM predictors cold-reset solver warmstart/time every20ms; the evaluation plant integrates continuously. Same native engine is not identical hidden contact state.
CEM wall time includes IPC and two concurrent local CPU episode jobs; it is not hardware-matched isolated PPO inference latency.
One episode per condition: no statistical superiority, realtime or hardware claim. Core accuracy alone can hide later falls; all original poses remain visible.
Persistent tilt is diagnostic only. Contact-count/Fz zeros are not flight labels; there is no absolute-height/contact failure gate.
Reference ends6.96s: full6.98s tracking is unavailable without extrapolation; tilt/contact/HF retain the full native horizon.

notes: Official MJCF/STL assets are preserved; generated robot.xml changes only meshdir, names the floating root joint, and adds IK/display sites.
left/right_wheel sites are wheel hinge centers, not human ankle frames; left/right_knee sites are actual knee joint centers.
left/right_contact are nominal local bottom markers: they rotate with the wheel and are NOT rolling contact points or reliable ground clearance. Compute clearance from collision geometry instead.

Official MJCF and Isaac USD share link offsets and joint axes, but are not numerically identical dynamics models. MJCF base includes fixed IMU mass; wheel collision axial width is 0.010m versus 0.050m in USD, and lateral collision offsets are +/-0.008m versus +/-0.00707m.
Official MJCF wheel motor ctrlrange is +/-40Nm, while the imported USD drive maxForce is 80. Other collision primitives also differ; no cross-engine contact or actuator equivalence is implied.
Mink IK playback does not validate contact forces, balance, jump actuation, self-collision avoidance, or dynamic feasibility. No Isaac assets or runtime are changed.

validation.note: Geometric/FK checks only. Contacts include margin contacts and do not prove dynamically feasible balance or jumping.
